parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: The time when the reboot occurred.

parameters.name: FirmwareUpdated
parameters.description: {{true}} if the Device was rebooted as a result of a firmware update; otherwise {{false}}.

parameters.name: Reason
parameters.description: The reason of the boot (e.g. power on reset, watchdog, overheat, FAN fault, web userinterface, ...).

object.description: Each table entry represents a reboot reason that is stored on the device. When the maximum {{object}} entries as indicated by {{param|#.MaxRebootEntries}} are reached, the next boot entry overrides the object with the oldest {{param|TimeStamp}}.
